title: ornithopus perpusillus subsp. roseus
intro: Ornithopus perpusillus subsp. roseus, commonly known as Rosy Crowfoot, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, including the potential to treat digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Ornithopus perpusillus subsp. roseus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and may provide relief from various health conditions.
